metadata.deploymentNote: Original XL330 policy; HD1910 hardware unvalidated. Right support / left lift; press again to lower. User requested original XML target angle limits only for this skill; physical range not newly validated.

command.head: unused (zeros)
twist: flag: 0 = stand on two feet (HOME), 1 = stand on one foot
side: +1 = right foot down / left leg lifted, -1 = left foot down / right leg lifted; 0 allowed while flag = 0

sourceManifest.description: Stand on one foot, either side, on command, and come back to a two-foot stand: twist = [flag, side, 0].

eval.battery: 10/10: right and left cycles, 0.1 m/s pushes toward either side, 0.15 m/s forward, a 0.3 m/s push toward the lifted side (brief touch-down, re-lift), lowering from a static hold, 10 s hold
eval.known_limits: falls on backward pushes >= 0.18 m/s; pushes toward the standing-foot side above ~0.15 m/s end in a step-down; never tested on hardware
eval.sim_proxy: CPU MuJoCo with the BAM XL330 servo model, allcollisions model
